Acted intention is the reference. Listeners screened recordings, but no per-clip listener emotion labels are published. Only three of nine participants are professional voice actors.

datasets.name: MultiDialog (gold_both)
datasets.parallel_detail: Performed TopicalChat conversations with prescribed emotion. Current gold_both plus whole-dialogue QC retains 7,672 utterances from 353 dialogues and six speaker IDs (a,b,c,f,g,i); the two source test splits contain twelve actor IDs.
datasets.label_detail: Labels are prescribed TopicalChat performance emotions. Curious to dive deeper maps to neutral. “Gold” means actor-level screening, not new per-utterance listener consensus. Whole-dialogue segmentation QC is applied.
